comment.body: Thanks for explaining that the Cloud PC is fullscreen-sized but clipped by the previous zone offset, and that Restore fixes it. A similar issue was disputed as a duplicate, so we are keeping this behavior separate. Please confirm whether it still reproduces on your current PowerToys and Windows App versions and whether the session is exclusive fullscreen or windowed.
